author: Original NOCTURNE close-up geometry generated for this site
format: glTF 2.0 GLB, Y-up, no external textures or Draco dependency
notes: Seven shouldered white-key profiles; tapered black key; rounded lacquer case profiles; radiused wood fingerboard; D-profile neck; six-slotted nut.
Models are adapted to the site coordinate system; key pivots, frets, strings and interaction events remain controlled by JavaScript.
